description: Claude's current 'Want me to make edits 1–4?' refers to four visible numbered recommendations, not an existing grid table. The phone must show their identifiers and substance with the question, without the later skipped recommendations. Synthetic: a review of a community-garden website PR. The parser, told to carry the list as a table, failed this repeatedly (September 2026, the queued-steer A/B, October 2026), so the prompt asks for the named rows as question.items instead of a table; classify() keeps those the screen shows. Pinned here by label, with no table.
